prompt:
A line-art multi-panel storyboard of one continuous scene of a live-action short drama: one image divided into a grid of 3 columns and 4 rows of equal 9:16 panels, 10 panels read from left to right and top to bottom; cells after the last panel stay plain white. Every panel is a colouring-book drawing: contours only, in one thin uniform black line on white, most of the panel left white. Draw only the people and the few large shapes of the place (walls, doors, windows, a bed, a car). People are simple storyboard figures: hair is one smooth outline of its shape, like a cap, empty inside, with no strands, curls or waves; a face has one short line each for the eyes, brows, nose and mouth, and no stubble, wrinkles or jaw lines; a fence is its posts and top rail, a tree its outline. No texture, mesh, bricks, leaves or fabric folds; no shading, grey or solid black: dark hair, clothes and cars are outlines left white inside. Thin black panel borders, plain white gutters. Location: INT. JI RAN'S OFFICE, Day, grey rainy daylight through the floor-to-ceiling windows, warm ceiling spots.
Image 1: the character sheet of Ji Ran (27), look S2
Image 2: the character sheet of Lin Qingyu (21), look S1
Image 3: the location INT. JI RAN'S OFFICE, the front view, the establishing view, facing the back wall, with no people
Image 4: the location INT. JI RAN'S OFFICE, the back view, turned 180 degrees, facing the front wall, with the left wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 5: the location INT. JI RAN'S OFFICE, the left-side view, facing the left wall, with the back wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 6: the location INT. JI RAN'S OFFICE, the right-side view, facing the right wall, with the back wall at its left edge, with no people
Image 7: the location INT. JI RAN'S OFFICE, the floor plan seen from above: its top edge is the back wall, its bottom edge the front wall behind the front view's camera, and its left and right edges the left and right walls, with no people
Image 8: the blocking reference of this segment, the same place with its people in their places at the start; use it only for where each person is and which way they face, and keep each person on that seat or spot, on the same side of the room, in every panel until a shot moves them; do not copy its colours or light
Draw each character so they can be told apart as in their reference image, by the shape of the hairstyle, the build and the outfit in outline only; never copy the photograph's detail. Use the character sheets only for the characters, not for their layout, white background or multiple views. Use the location images only for the layout of the space and the place of its furniture and props, drawn in outline. There is only one of each vehicle, piece of furniture and prop that the location shows, defined by the location images, throughout all panels; when a panel shows only part of one, such as a car's hood, it is that same object, and no second one appears. Each panel shows only the characters it names, and nobody appears twice in one panel.
At the start: Camera on the front-wall side, by the pin-up wall, facing the walnut desk and the walnut door on the right wall. Lin Qingyu stands on the pale oak floor just inside the closed walnut door, soaked, sweating, facing the desk. Ji Ran stands in front of him on the desk side, arms folded, facing him. Xu Banxia has left through the walnut door, which is shut. The walnut desk and black leather chair stay in front of the floor-to-ceiling windows.
Panel 1: Medium shot, over-the-shoulder from behind Lin Qingyu, eye level, angled toward the desk. Over Lin Qingyu's wet shoulder, Ji Ran tilts her head, arms folded, sizing him up.
Panel 2: Medium shot, locked-off camera, low angle on Lin Qingyu, from the pin-up wall side angled toward the walnut door, clean single. Lin Qingyu straightens up to his full height and squares his shoulders.
Panel 3: Medium close-up, locked-off camera, eye level on Ji Ran, from the pin-up wall side angled toward the desk, clean single. Ji Ran glances down at his waist, one brow raised.
Panel 4: Medium shot, handheld, eye level, dirty single of Lin Qingyu with Ji Ran's shoulder at the frame edge. Lin Qingyu nods quickly, water dripping from his fringe onto his denim jacket.
Panel 5: Medium shot, slow push in on Ji Ran, eye level, from the pin-up wall side angled toward the desk, clean single. Ji Ran unfolds one hand and taps her chin, eyes narrowing.
Panel 6: Close-up, locked-off camera, eye level, clean single of Lin Qingyu framed tight on face and shoulders. Lin Qingyu flashes a bright, boyish, dimpled smile.
Panel 7: Medium shot, locked-off camera, eye level on Ji Ran, Lin Qingyu's shoulder in the foreground. Ji Ran closes her eyes and sighs, her shoulders dropping in disappointment, arms falling to her sides.
Panel 8: Medium shot, locked-off camera, low angle on Ji Ran, from the pin-up wall side angled toward the desk, Lin Qingyu's shoulder at the frame edge. Ji Ran turns her head and points past Lin Qingyu toward the walnut door, expression flat.
Panel 9: Close-up, quick push in on Lin Qingyu, eye level, clean single framed tight on face. Lin Qingyu's smile freezes, his eyes widen and his mouth falls open.
Panel 10: Wide shot, slow pull out, eye level, from the pin-up wall facing the desk and the walnut door. Ji Ran stands in front of Lin Qingyu with her arm still pointing at the walnut door while he stares at her; the image softens into drifting, glowing light.
Keep the characters, the number and position of every vehicle, piece of furniture and prop, and the location's spatial orientation consistent across all panels.
No text, letters, numbers, captions, speech bubbles, panel labels or watermark anywhere in the image; no photographic rendering.
